device.name: WiZ Wi-Fi Lights (bulbs, strips, plugs)
device.notes:
WiZ is Signify's (Philips) budget smart-lighting line — bulbs, light strips and plugs — controllable entirely on the LAN over a small UDP/JSON protocol with no cloud and no account once the light is on the network. pywizlight is the reference client and backs Home Assistant's wiz integration.
TRANSPORT: UDP JSON datagrams. The light LISTENS on port 38899; the app/ client receives pushes on port 38900. No authentication. Discovery is a UDP broadcast of a "registration" message to the broadcast address; every bulb replies.
ENVELOPE: { "method": "", "params": {}, "result": {}, "error": {} } — UTF-8 JSON; not every field is present in every packet.
METHODS:
  setPilot        — change state, e.g. {"method":"setPilot","params":{"state":true}}
                    or {"r":255,"g":0,"b":0} or {"dimming":50} or {"sceneId":12}
  getPilot        — read current state
  syncPilot       — the light pushes its state to registered clients
  registration    — register a client for pushes; doubles as the discovery probe
  getSystemConfig / setSystemConfig, getUserConfig / setUserConfig — device config
  pulse           — brief fade effect (delta + duration)
Params: r/g/b 0-255, dimming, colour temperature in Kelvin (range varies by bulb class), sceneId 1-35, effect speed. MACs appear as 12-digit lowercase hex strings.

openness.notes: No vendor protocol documentation; pywizlight and OpenWiz reverse-engineered the LAN API. pywizlight backs Home Assistant.

credentials.notes: Onboarding is handled by the WiZ app and not documented here, so the passphrase protection during provisioning is unknown. Post-setup UDP control is unauthenticated on the LAN.

factory_reset.effect: Clears Wi-Fi credentials and returns the bulb to onboarding. Done by power-cycling the bulb several times (the WiZ-documented toggle-on/off sequence); the exact count is not transcribed here.

procedures.basis: WiZ documents a repeated power-cycle to reset; not replayed here.
procedures.name: Power-cycle reset

steps.action: Toggle the bulb's power on/off several times per WiZ's instructions until it pulses to confirm reset.

methods.description: Onboard the bulb onto Wi-Fi via the WiZ app (SoftAP/SmartConfig-style). After it joins, the UDP 38899 protocol answers directly — no account, no LAN toggle.

steps.action: Add the bulb in the WiZ app and give it the home Wi-Fi credentials.
steps.expect: The bulb joins the LAN and answers a getPilot on UDP 38899.

setup.notes: A new bulb is joined to Wi-Fi through the WiZ app; once on the network the UDP protocol answers with no cloud step and no per-device LAN-enable toggle. The onboarding wire flow is not documented in the sources used.

rejoin.notes: No documented in-place Wi-Fi credential rewrite over the local protocol; treat a network change as a reprovision through the app.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. The UDP 38899/38900 ports are from OpenWiz; the JSON method dialect is from both pywizlight and OpenWiz.
